text.text_excerpt: Went here for an early Mother's day dinner to beat the Mother's day rush, and plus, to try this place out! Figured this would be a good place choose aside from your bigger chained Italian restaurants. The restaurant is very spacious with plenty of tables around along with a stocked bar area. I called ahead to reserve a table to make sure we won't have to wait because you know, it's Mother's day weekend. We were greeted and seated right when we walked in which the host were on their job. Our server was very polite and attentive to our needs throughout our time there making sure we had refills and/or other condiments. This is a new addition to an area that I've dubbed "restaurant row" in Lakeview. This is a fantastic little spot in the building that used to house Mondo and I just love the feel and atmosphere. My dad and I stopped in here for lunch and I immediately loved the vibe: relaxed lunch with an upscale feel. I decided to start with an order of the She Crab Bisque because I do make a habit of indulging whenever I see it on a menu. It was fabulous! Tasty and rich- a great start to the meal. For my entree I had the Shrimp Lucci, which came highly recommended by the waitress. This was shrimp tossed with mushrooms and pasta with a light buttery sauce. This was AMAZING! I try to wait for new spaces to work out the kinks before giving them a try, but I heard good things, so I took my chances. My husband and I were lucky enough to snag a 2 top at around 6:00 without a reservation. Within about 15 minutes the restaurant was completely full. I'll definitely make a reservation next go round. The menu is full of all things Italian, and everything coming out of the kitchen looked delicious and generous in size. We knew we wanted pizza and did our best to stick to our plan.
